title: ASF Public School & College Lahore, Lahore | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: ASF Public School & College Lahore, located in Lahore, Pakistan. Address: Khawaja Road, Walton, Punjab, Askari 5, Lahore. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=31.503,74.348. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site.
